summary: npm package ships a static Cloudflare-Turnstile lookalike HTML page with no installer-side execution
details: The package consists of a single index.html file styled as a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' Turnstile challenge, containing an obfuscated IIFE (hex-named identifiers, string-array dispatcher) that constructs a runtime URL referencing challenges.cloudflare.com. package.json declares no lifecycle scripts (no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) and sets main to index.html, which cannot be loaded as JavaScript via require() or import. Installing or requiring this package therefore executes no code on the installer's machine. The content appears intended for use as a phishing landing page hosted elsewhere; any harm would fall on end users who visit the page where it is served, not on developers who install the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
